panels.title: Failed disks
panels.description: Number of data disks currently flagged failed (EIO/EROFS). Anything above 0 needs attention: the disk is skipped for new writes.

targets.query: SELECT sum("g") AS "failed disks" FROM (SELECT last("value") AS "g" FROM "dtfs_data_disk_failed" WHERE $timeFilter AND "dc" =~ /^$dc$/ AND "node" =~ /^$node$/ AND "disk" =~ /^$disk$/ GROUP BY time($__interval), "node", "disk" fill(null)) GROUP BY time($__interval) fill(null)

panels.title: Quarantines in range
panels.description: Chunks quarantined (renamed to .bad) on the selected disks during the selected time range. Normally 0.

targets.query: SELECT sum("s") AS "quarantines" FROM (SELECT spread("value") AS "s" FROM "dtfs_data_quarantines_total" WHERE $timeFilter AND "dc" =~ /^$dc$/ AND "node" =~ /^$node$/ AND "disk" =~ /^$disk$/ GROUP BY "node", "disk")

panels.title: Read data loss in range
panels.description: Reads that failed checksum verification during the selected range. Normally 0; any hit means a replica served bad bytes.

targets.query: SELECT sum("s") AS "data loss" FROM (SELECT spread("value") AS "s" FROM "dtfs_data_get_data_loss_total" WHERE $timeFilter AND "dc" =~ /^$dc$/ AND "node" =~ /^$node$/ AND "disk" =~ /^$disk$/ GROUP BY "node", "disk")

panels.title: Least free disk space
panels.description: Smallest free space on any selected disk. Red below 10 GB, yellow below 50 GB.

targets.query: SELECT min("g") AS "least free" FROM (SELECT mean("value") AS "g" FROM "dtfs_data_disk_free_bytes" WHERE $timeFilter AND "dc" =~ /^$dc$/ AND "node" =~ /^$node$/ AND "disk" =~ /^$disk$/ GROUP BY time($__interval), "node", "disk" fill(null)) GROUP BY time($__interval) fill(null)

panels.title: Put p99
panels.description: Worst PutChunk p99 across the selected disks (whole call, includes the network receive). Compare per disk in the Put and get section.

targets.query: SELECT max("p99") AS "p99" FROM "dtfs_data_put_total_us" WHERE $timeFilter AND "dc" =~ /^$dc$/ AND "node" =~ /^$node$/ AND "disk" =~ /^$disk$/ GROUP BY time($__interval) fill(null)

panels.title: Get p99
panels.description: Worst GetChunk p99 across the selected disks (whole call, includes the send to the client).

targets.query: SELECT max("p99") AS "p99" FROM "dtfs_data_get_total_us" WHERE $timeFilter AND "dc" =~ /^$dc$/ AND "node" =~ /^$node$/ AND "disk" =~ /^$disk$/ GROUP BY time($__interval) fill(null)

panels.title: Disk used vs total
panels.description: Used and total bytes per disk. Used approaching total means the disk is filling up.

targets.query: SELECT mean("value") AS "used" FROM "dtfs_data_disk_used_bytes" WHERE $timeFilter AND "dc" =~ /^$dc$/ AND "node" =~ /^$node$/ AND "disk" =~ /^$disk$/ GROUP BY time($__interval), "node", "disk", "tier" fill(null)

SELECT mean("value") AS "total" FROM "dtfs_data_disk_total_bytes" WHERE $timeFilter AND "dc" =~ /^$dc$/ AND "node" =~ /^$node$/ AND "disk" =~ /^$disk$/ GROUP BY time($__interval), "node", "disk", "tier" fill(null)

panels.title: Disk free
panels.description: Free bytes per disk. Falling toward zero predicts ENOSPC on puts.

targets.query: SELECT mean("value") AS "free" FROM "dtfs_data_disk_free_bytes" WHERE $timeFilter AND "dc" =~ /^$dc$/ AND "node" =~ /^$node$/ AND "disk" =~ /^$disk$/ GROUP BY time($__interval), "node", "disk", "tier" fill(null)

panels.title: Disk failed
panels.description: Failed flag per disk: green is ok, red is failed (EIO/EROFS seen). A failed disk takes no new writes.

targets.query: SELECT max("value") AS "failed" FROM "dtfs_data_disk_failed" WHERE $timeFilter AND "dc" =~ /^$dc$/ AND "node" =~ /^$node$/ AND "disk" =~ /^$disk$/ GROUP BY time($__interval), "node", "disk", "tier" fill(null)

panels.title: Store chunks and bytes
panels.description: Chunks (right axis) and bytes held by each data node's store. Steady growth is normal; a sudden drop means chunks were removed.

targets.query: SELECT mean("value") AS "chunks" FROM "dtfs_data_store_chunks" WHERE $timeFilter AND "dc" =~ /^$dc$/ AND "node" =~ /^$node$/ GROUP BY time($__interval), "node" fill(null)
SELECT mean("value") AS "bytes" FROM "dtfs_data_store_bytes" WHERE $timeFilter AND "dc" =~ /^$dc$/ AND "node" =~ /^$node$/ GROUP BY time($__interval), "node" fill(null)

panels.title: Put latency p99 per disk
panels.description: PutChunk p99 per disk, whole call. A disk much slower than its peers is the first suspect; the stage panels below isolate where.

targets.query: SELECT max("p99") AS "p99" FROM "dtfs_data_put_total_us" WHERE $timeFilter AND "dc" =~ /^$dc$/ AND "node" =~ /^$node$/ AND "disk" =~ /^$disk$/ GROUP BY time($__interval), "node", "disk", "tier" fill(null)

panels.title: Get latency p99 per disk
panels.description: GetChunk p99 per disk, whole call. High values on one disk point at a slow or failing drive.

targets.query: SELECT max("p99") AS "p99" FROM "dtfs_data_get_total_us" WHERE $timeFilter AND "dc" =~ /^$dc$/ AND "node" =~ /^$node$/ AND "disk" =~ /^$disk$/ GROUP BY time($__interval), "node", "disk", "tier" fill(null)

panels.title: Put fsync p99 per disk
panels.description: Time to fsync the chunk file per disk, p99. A slow HDD shows up here first; healthy disks stay in the low milliseconds.

targets.query: SELECT max("p99") AS "p99" FROM "dtfs_data_put_fsync_dat_us" WHERE $timeFilter AND "dc" =~ /^$dc$/ AND "node" =~ /^$node$/ AND "disk" =~ /^$disk$/ GROUP BY time($__interval), "node", "disk", "tier" fill(null)

panels.title: Put tmp write p99 per disk
panels.description: Time to write the chunk to its tmp file per disk, p99. Separates write-cache or throughput trouble from fsync trouble.

targets.query: SELECT max("p99") AS "p99" FROM "dtfs_data_put_tmp_write_us" WHERE $timeFilter AND "dc" =~ /^$dc$/ AND "node" =~ /^$node$/ AND "disk" =~ /^$disk$/ GROUP BY time($__interval), "node", "disk", "tier" fill(null)

panels.title: Throughput per disk
panels.description: Bytes stored (put) and served (get) per second per disk.

targets.query: SELECT non_negative_derivative(last("value"), 1s) AS "put" FROM "dtfs_data_put_bytes_total" WHERE $timeFilter AND "dc" =~ /^$dc$/ AND "node" =~ /^$node$/ AND "disk" =~ /^$disk$/ GROUP BY time($__interval), "node", "disk", "tier" fill(null)

SELECT non_negative_derivative(last("value"), 1s) AS "get" FROM "dtfs_data_get_bytes_total" WHERE $timeFilter AND "dc" =~ /^$dc$/ AND "node" =~ /^$node$/ AND "disk" =~ /^$disk$/ GROUP BY time($__interval), "node", "disk", "tier" fill(null)

panels.title: Operations per disk
panels.description: Chunk puts and gets per second per disk.

targets.query: SELECT non_negative_derivative(last("value"), 1s) AS "puts" FROM "dtfs_data_puts_total" WHERE $timeFilter AND "dc" =~ /^$dc$/ AND "node" =~ /^$node$/ AND "disk" =~ /^$disk$/ GROUP BY time($__interval), "node", "disk", "tier" fill(null)

SELECT non_negative_derivative(last("value"), 1s) AS "gets" FROM "dtfs_data_gets_total" WHERE $timeFilter AND "dc" =~ /^$dc$/ AND "node" =~ /^$node$/ AND "disk" =~ /^$disk$/ GROUP BY time($__interval), "node", "disk", "tier" fill(null)

panels.title: Put and get inflight
panels.description: PutChunk and GetChunk calls currently in progress per node. Sustained high values with rising latency mean the node is saturated.

targets.query: SELECT mean("value") AS "put inflight" FROM "dtfs_data_put_inflight" WHERE $timeFilter AND "dc" =~ /^$dc$/ AND "node" =~ /^$node$/ GROUP BY time($__interval), "node" fill(null)
SELECT mean("value") AS "get inflight" FROM "dtfs_data_get_inflight" WHERE $timeFilter AND "dc" =~ /^$dc$/ AND "node" =~ /^$node$/ GROUP BY time($__interval), "node" fill(null)

panels.title: Put slot wait p99
panels.description: How long a put waits for a free put slot, p99. Normally near zero; growth means puts are queueing behind the memory or concurrency cap.

targets.query: SELECT max("p99") AS "p99" FROM "dtfs_data_put_slot_wait_us" WHERE $timeFilter AND "dc" =~ /^$dc$/ AND "node" =~ /^$node$/ GROUP BY time($__interval), "node" fill(null)

panels.title: gRPC latency p99 by method
panels.description: p99 latency per gRPC method per node (max across each window).

targets.query: SELECT max("p99") AS "p99" FROM "dtfs_data_grpc_latency_us" WHERE $timeFilter AND "dc" =~ /^$dc$/ AND "node" =~ /^$node$/ GROUP BY time($__interval), "node", "method" fill(null)

panels.title: gRPC requests by method
panels.description: gRPC requests per second per method.

targets.query: SELECT non_negative_derivative(last("value"), 1s) AS "requests" FROM "dtfs_data_grpc_requests_total" WHERE $timeFilter AND "dc" =~ /^$dc$/ AND "node" =~ /^$node$/ GROUP BY time($__interval), "node", "method" fill(null)

panels.title: gRPC errors by method and code
panels.description: gRPC calls that returned an error, per second by method and status code. Should be flat zero; data_loss or unavailable deserve a look.

targets.query: SELECT non_negative_derivative(last("value"), 1s) AS "errors" FROM "dtfs_data_grpc_errors_total" WHERE $timeFilter AND "dc" =~ /^$dc$/ AND "node" =~ /^$node$/ GROUP BY time($__interval), "node", "method", "code" fill(null)

panels.title: gRPC inflight by method
panels.description: gRPC calls currently in flight per method.

targets.query: SELECT mean("value") AS "inflight" FROM "dtfs_data_grpc_inflight" WHERE $timeFilter AND "dc" =~ /^$dc$/ AND "node" =~ /^$node$/ GROUP BY time($__interval), "node", "method" fill(null)

panels.title: Rejects, sheds and not-found
panels.description: Rejected puts by gRPC code, puts shed under memory pressure and gets for unknown chunks, per second. Sheds mean the node is overloaded.

targets.query: SELECT non_negative_derivative(last("value"), 1s) AS "put rejects" FROM "dtfs_data_put_rejects_total" WHERE $timeFilter AND "dc" =~ /^$dc$/ AND "node" =~ /^$node$/ GROUP BY time($__interval), "node", "method", "code" fill(null)

SELECT non_negative_derivative(last("value"), 1s) AS "put shed" FROM "dtfs_data_put_shed_total" WHERE $timeFilter AND "dc" =~ /^$dc$/ AND "node" =~ /^$node$/ GROUP BY time($__interval), "node" fill(null)

SELECT non_negative_derivative(last("value"), 1s) AS "get not found" FROM "dtfs_data_get_not_found_total" WHERE $timeFilter AND "dc" =~ /^$dc$/ AND "node" =~ /^$node$/ GROUP BY time($__interval), "node" fill(null)

panels.title: Scrub throughput
panels.description: Bytes verified by the background scrub per second per disk.

targets.query: SELECT non_negative_derivative(last("value"), 1s) AS "scrub" FROM "dtfs_data_scrub_bytes_total" WHERE $timeFilter AND "dc" =~ /^$dc$/ AND "node" =~ /^$node$/ AND "disk" =~ /^$disk$/ GROUP BY time($__interval), "node", "disk", "tier" fill(null)

panels.title: Scrub chunks
panels.description: Chunks verified by the scrub per second per disk. Zero means no scrub pass is running on that disk.

targets.query: SELECT non_negative_derivative(last("value"), 1s) AS "chunks" FROM "dtfs_data_scrub_chunks_total" WHERE $timeFilter AND "dc" =~ /^$dc$/ AND "node" =~ /^$node$/ AND "disk" =~ /^$disk$/ GROUP BY time($__interval), "node", "disk", "tier" fill(null)

panels.title: Scrub throttle time
panels.description: Microseconds of throttle sleep per second of wall time per disk (1 s means fully throttled). High values mean the scrub is rate-limited, not that the disk is slow.

targets.query: SELECT non_negative_derivative(last("value"), 1s) AS "throttle" FROM "dtfs_data_scrub_throttle_us_total" WHERE $timeFilter AND "dc" =~ /^$dc$/ AND "node" =~ /^$node$/ AND "disk" =~ /^$disk$/ GROUP BY time($__interval), "node", "disk", "tier" fill(null)

panels.title: Quarantines and read data loss
panels.description: Chunks quarantined and reads that failed verification, per second per disk. Any non-zero line is an integrity event.

targets.query: SELECT non_negative_derivative(last("value"), 1s) AS "quarantines" FROM "dtfs_data_quarantines_total" WHERE $timeFilter AND "dc" =~ /^$dc$/ AND "node" =~ /^$node$/ AND "disk" =~ /^$disk$/ GROUP BY time($__interval), "node", "disk", "tier" fill(null)

SELECT non_negative_derivative(last("value"), 1s) AS "data loss" FROM "dtfs_data_get_data_loss_total" WHERE $timeFilter AND "dc" =~ /^$dc$/ AND "node" =~ /^$node$/ AND "disk" =~ /^$disk$/ GROUP BY time($__interval), "node", "disk", "tier" fill(null)

panels.title: Scrub findings
panels.description: Scrub findings per second per disk: corrupt, missing, size mismatch, meta repaired and I/O errors. Only meta repaired is benign.

targets.query: SELECT non_negative_derivative(last("value"), 1s) AS "corrupt" FROM "dtfs_data_scrub_corrupt_total" WHERE $timeFilter AND "dc" =~ /^$dc$/ AND "node" =~ /^$node$/ AND "disk" =~ /^$disk$/ GROUP BY time($__interval), "node", "disk", "tier" fill(null)

SELECT non_negative_derivative(last("value"), 1s) AS "missing" FROM "dtfs_data_scrub_missing_total" WHERE $timeFilter AND "dc" =~ /^$dc$/ AND "node" =~ /^$node$/ AND "disk" =~ /^$disk$/ GROUP BY time($__interval), "node", "disk", "tier" fill(null)

SELECT non_negative_derivative(last("value"), 1s) AS "size mismatch" FROM "dtfs_data_scrub_size_mismatch_total" WHERE $timeFilter AND "dc" =~ /^$dc$/ AND "node" =~ /^$node$/ AND "disk" =~ /^$disk$/ GROUP BY time($__interval), "node", "disk", "tier" fill(null)

SELECT non_negative_derivative(last("value"), 1s) AS "meta repaired" FROM "dtfs_data_scrub_meta_repaired_total" WHERE $timeFilter AND "dc" =~ /^$dc$/ AND "node" =~ /^$node$/ AND "disk" =~ /^$disk$/ GROUP BY time($__interval), "node", "disk", "tier" fill(null)

SELECT non_negative_derivative(last("value"), 1s) AS "io errors" FROM "dtfs_data_scrub_io_errors_total" WHERE $timeFilter AND "dc" =~ /^$dc$/ AND "node" =~ /^$node$/ AND "disk" =~ /^$disk$/ GROUP BY time($__interval), "node", "disk", "tier" fill(null)

panels.title: Replication out bytes by peer
panels.description: Bytes per second this node sends to each replication peer.

targets.query: SELECT non_negative_derivative(last("value"), 1s) AS "bytes" FROM "dtfs_data_replicate_out_bytes_total" WHERE $timeFilter AND "dc" =~ /^$dc$/ AND "node" =~ /^$node$/ GROUP BY time($__interval), "node", "peer" fill(null)

panels.title: Replication out operations and failures
panels.description: Completed and failed outgoing replications per second by peer. Failures should be flat zero.

targets.query: SELECT non_negative_derivative(last("value"), 1s) AS "copies" FROM "dtfs_data_replicate_out_total" WHERE $timeFilter AND "dc" =~ /^$dc$/ AND "node" =~ /^$node$/ GROUP BY time($__interval), "node", "peer" fill(null)

SELECT non_negative_derivative(last("value"), 1s) AS "failures" FROM "dtfs_data_replicate_out_failures_total" WHERE $timeFilter AND "dc" =~ /^$dc$/ AND "node" =~ /^$node$/ GROUP BY time($__interval), "node", "peer" fill(null)

panels.title: Replication out latency p99
panels.description: p99 latency of outgoing replication per peer. WAN peers are slower by design.

targets.query: SELECT max("p99") AS "p99" FROM "dtfs_data_replicate_out_us" WHERE $timeFilter AND "dc" =~ /^$dc$/ AND "node" =~ /^$node$/ GROUP BY time($__interval), "node", "peer" fill(null)

panels.title: Heartbeat latency p99
panels.description: p99 latency of the heartbeat call to the manager. Spikes precede missed heartbeats.

targets.query: SELECT max("p99") AS "p99" FROM "dtfs_data_heartbeat_us" WHERE $timeFilter AND "dc" =~ /^$dc$/ AND "node" =~ /^$node$/ GROUP BY time($__interval), "node" fill(null)

panels.title: Heartbeat failures and rejections
panels.description: Heartbeats that failed to reach the manager or were refused, per second. Should be flat zero.

targets.query: SELECT non_negative_derivative(last("value"), 1s) AS "failures" FROM "dtfs_data_heartbeat_failures_total" WHERE $timeFilter AND "dc" =~ /^$dc$/ AND "node" =~ /^$node$/ GROUP BY time($__interval), "node" fill(null)

SELECT non_negative_derivative(last("value"), 1s) AS "rejected" FROM "dtfs_data_heartbeat_rejected_total" WHERE $timeFilter AND "dc" =~ /^$dc$/ AND "node" =~ /^$node$/ GROUP BY time($__interval), "node" fill(null)

list.name: dc
list.label: DC
list.query: SHOW TAG VALUES FROM "dtfs_data_disk_used_bytes" WITH KEY = "dc"
list.definition: SHOW TAG VALUES FROM "dtfs_data_disk_used_bytes" WITH KEY = "dc"

list.name: node
list.label: Node
list.query: SHOW TAG VALUES FROM "dtfs_data_disk_used_bytes" WITH KEY = "node" WHERE "dc" =~ /^$dc$/
list.definition: SHOW TAG VALUES FROM "dtfs_data_disk_used_bytes" WITH KEY = "node" WHERE "dc" =~ /^$dc$/

list.name: disk
list.label: Disk
list.query: SHOW TAG VALUES FROM "dtfs_data_disk_used_bytes" WITH KEY = "disk" WHERE "dc" =~ /^$dc$/ AND "node" =~ /^$node$/
list.definition: SHOW TAG VALUES FROM "dtfs_data_disk_used_bytes" WITH KEY = "disk" WHERE "dc" =~ /^$dc$/ AND "node" =~ /^$node$/
